content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy promise simplicity but fail in restricted regions. They rely on Stripe or PayPal, which are unavailable in Ghana. Self-hosted solutions like COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. The tradeoff is clear: platforms offer convenience until they don’t, while self-hosted stacks require initial setup but deliver sovereignty. With COREMERCH, you own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform can shut you down or change terms overnight. This architecture is built for creators who prioritize control over convenience.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Gumroad or Paddle exclude Ghana outright due to payment processor restrictions. Even if you use a VPN, your payout options remain nonexistent. Self-hosted solutions bypass this entirely. By leveraging blockchain payments, COREMERCH’s stacks accept 300+ cryptocurrencies without KYC or geographic barriers. Buyers in Ghana or anywhere else pay directly to your wallet. The infrastructure is borderless by design. Cloudflare’s global network ensures your store loads fast, while NOWPayments handles payment verification instantly. This isn’t a workaround—it’s a rearchitecting of commerce to remove geographic dependency.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms charge 5-10% per transaction, plus payment processor fees. In Ghana, where those processors are unavailable, the total cost is infinite—you cannot sell. COREMERCH’s stacks use NOWPayments, which charges 0.5% for crypto transactions. Recommended networks like BSC or Solana keep transaction fees under $0.10. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes, triggering automatic product delivery. The real cost is the $197 for the Complete Builder Kit, which includes lifetime access to all blueprints and templates. After deployment, your only ongoing cost is the 0.5% payment fee. No subscriptions. No hidden charges. Full transparency.
Self-hosted stacks remove geographic barriers entirely—no more platform rejections.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms own your customer data, your store, and your revenue stream. They can suspend your account or change terms without notice. With COREMERCH’s self-hosted stacks, you own everything. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and payments are verified directly on-chain. Automation is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring instant delivery without manual intervention. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your stack. You control the infrastructure, the data, and the customer relationship. This is sovereignty, not dependency.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in Ghana and need to sell digital products today, platforms are not an option. Self-hosted solutions like COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit are the only architecture that works. Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack if you’re new to self-hosting, or deploy the Edge Commerce Stack for advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. The Complete Builder Kit includes all blueprints and templates, allowing you to scale as your business grows. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution. Choose sovereignty over convenience. Build infrastructure that cannot be taken away.
